question: How many distinct customers are in the dataset?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM customers

question: How many distinct products are in the dataset?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_products FROM products

question: What is the total revenue from completed orders?
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

question: How many completed orders are there?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

question: Which city has the most customers?
expected_sql: SELECT city FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average order value for completed orders?
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(total_amount) AS avg_order_value FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

question: Which product has the highest total revenue from completed orders?
expected_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many product categories are there?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT category) AS total_categories FROM products

question: What is the total revenue per product category from completed orders?
expected_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Who is the customer with the highest total spending on completed orders?
expected_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the monthly revenue for completed orders, ordered by month?
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: How many customers have placed more than one completed order?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

question: Which customers have never placed any order?
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM orders) ORDER BY name

question: What are the top 5 products by total quantity sold across all orders?
expected_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY total_sold DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which product categories have total revenue from completed orders exceeding 10000?
expected_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) > 10000 ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: What is the average number of items per completed order?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(item_count), 2) AS avg_items_per_order FROM (SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS item_count FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY oi.order_id)

question: For each customer, what is the total number of distinct products they have ever ordered?
expected_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS distinct_products FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY distinct_products DESC
